nodes.name: AgentBrowserOverlay.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a full-screen overlay with a live screencast and take-over/resume/stop controls shown while an AI agent is remotely controlling the Chrome browser.

nodes.name: browserLayoutUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Utility helpers that build human-readable labels and text summaries for a selected DOM element, used when sending element context to agent chat.

nodes.name: buildDomComponentJson.ts
nodes.summary: Serializes an inspected DOM element into a structured JSON payload (tag, attributes, text, source location) for sending to the AI agent as component context.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level layout orchestrator for Browser mode that composes the primary sidebar, webview viewport, DevTools/inspector panel, and status bar, wiring together session and tab state.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript prop and type definitions shared across the BrowserLayout component tree.

nodes.name: useBrowserLayoutState.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook that centralizes BrowserLayout state and behavior, wiring together automation, sessions, pane state, tab sync, status bar, and navigation shortcuts into a single interface consumed by the layout component.

nodes.name: useBrowserStatusBar.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook that derives Browser mode status bar state (URL, loading, selection, DevTools toggle) and wires the "send selected element to chat" action.

nodes.name: useBrowserTabSync.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook that synchronizes browser session lifecycle (new, closing, active) with the shared workstation tab bar, creating, removing, and reordering session tabs as sessions change.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Primary sidebar component for Browser mode that hosts the Sessions, History, and Design sub-tabs and renders the corresponding tab bar and content.

nodes.name: actions.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the toolbar action button definitions (filter, collapse-all, add-page, refresh) shown for the Design tab's Pages and Global Tokens sections.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Shared icon-size constants used across the Design tab's action buttons, tree rows, and empty states.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the Design tab that re-exports its section components, action builders, and types as a single public surface.

nodes.name: DesignTabGlobalTokens.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Global Tokens section of the Design tab, scanning and displaying repository design tokens in a filterable tree.

nodes.name: DesignTabPages.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Pages section of the Design tab as a filterable tree of the repository's page components.

nodes.name: DesignTreeContent.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared virtualization-friendly tree renderer used by both the Pages and Global Tokens sections of the Design tab, flattening a nested tree into rows and handling selection/expansion.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the DesignTabPages and DesignTabGlobalTokens section components.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript types for Design tab components, action items, and configuration options.

nodes.name: HistoryTab.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the browsing History tab, grouping past sessions into Today/Last 7 Days/Last 30 Days sections and deduplicating by URL.

nodes.name: SessionsTab.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the active browser Sessions tab listing, showing session titles/status and handling selection and close actions.

nodes.name: BrowserSidebar.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar component for the session-replay simulator view that lists categorized browser activity entries (native actions, agent browser events, internal browser tabs) with windowed rendering.

nodes.name: AgentBrowserOverlay
nodes.summary: Memoized React component rendering the agent-controlling overlay: toolbar with pause/resume/stop, live screencast image, and current URL footer.

nodes.name: buildSelectedElementLabel
nodes.summary: Builds a short display label (tag plus optional class/id selector) for a selected DOM element.

nodes.name: buildSelectedElementText
nodes.summary: Builds a multi-line plain-text description of a selected DOM element (tag, selector, size, text) for sending to chat.

nodes.name: buildFileName
nodes.summary: Derives a pseudo file name for a DOM element from its component name or tag, used as a label in the generated component JSON.

nodes.name: filterDataAttributes
nodes.summary: Filters an element's attribute map down to data-* attributes only.

nodes.name: buildDomComponentJsonFromElementInfo
nodes.summary: Converts inspected DOM element info (tag, attributes, text, source location) into a structured JSON payload consumed by the AI agent.

nodes.name: useBrowserLayoutState
nodes.summary: Aggregates browser automation, session, pane, tab-sync, and status-bar state and behavior into the single state object consumed by BrowserLayout.

nodes.name: useBrowserStatusBar
nodes.summary: Computes Browser mode status bar props and registers the callback used to send a selected DOM element to agent chat.

nodes.name: useBrowserTabSync
nodes.summary: Keeps the shared workstation tab bar in sync with browser session lifecycle, creating tabs for new sessions, removing tabs for closed sessions, and reordering the active tab.

nodes.name: BrowserPrimarySidebar
nodes.summary: Renders the Browser mode primary sidebar shell, switching between Sessions, History, and Design tab content and rendering the tab bar.

nodes.name: getPagesActions
nodes.summary: Builds the toolbar action buttons (filter toggle, collapse all, add page) for the Design tab Pages section.

nodes.name: getGlobalTokensActions
nodes.summary: Builds the toolbar action buttons (filter toggle, refresh) for the Design tab Global Tokens section.

nodes.name: DesignTabGlobalTokens
nodes.summary: Component that scans and renders repository design tokens as a filterable tree with refresh support.

nodes.name: DesignTabPages
nodes.summary: Component that renders the repository's pages as a filterable tree in the Design tab.

nodes.name: flattenDesignTree
nodes.summary: Recursively flattens a nested design tree into an ordered list of visible rows, respecting collapsed directory state.

nodes.name: toTreeRowNode
nodes.summary: Maps a design tree node plus flattening context into the row view-model consumed by the tree renderer.

nodes.name: DesignTreeContent
nodes.summary: Renders the flattened design tree as selectable/expandable rows, shared by the Pages and Global Tokens sections.

nodes.name: buildHistoryGroups
nodes.summary: Deduplicates browser history entries by URL and groups the latest visits into Today, Last 7 Days, and Last 30 Days buckets, sorted by recency.

nodes.name: HistoryTab
nodes.summary: Renders the browsing History tab UI using the grouped history sections and open-URL callback.

nodes.name: SessionsTab
nodes.summary: Renders the list of active browser sessions with selection and close controls.

nodes.name: getWindowedRows
nodes.summary: Computes a windowed slice of entries around the active entry plus a trailing visible count, used for progressive list rendering.

nodes.name: getNativeActionIcon
nodes.summary: Maps a native browser action type to its display icon, applying active-state styling.

nodes.name: getCategoryIcon
nodes.summary: Resolves the display icon for a browser sidebar entry based on its category (agent action, event, etc.).

nodes.name: EntryList
nodes.summary: Renders a windowed, expandable list of categorized browser entries with a show-more control.

nodes.name: NativeEntryList
nodes.summary: Renders a windowed, expandable list of native browser action entries with a show-more control.

nodes.name: BrowserSidebarComponent
nodes.summary: Root implementation of the session-replay sidebar that categorizes entries by type and renders the corresponding EntryList/NativeEntryList sections; exported publicly as the memoized BrowserSidebar.
